findings.claim: The change modifies network/trust boundaries without updating SECURITY.md or a security/privacy design document.
findings.evidence: Constraint `security-docs-updated` requires SECURITY.md or security/privacy design docs to be updated when a trust, credential, network, path, subprocess, or disclosure boundary changes; the diff enables official binaries with `--features surreal-remote` in `.github/workflows/compass-release.yml`, adds MCP legacy HTTP sessions/session IDs in `crates/compass-mcp/src/transport.rs`, and updates only CHANGELOG/COMPATIBILITY/agent docs.
findings.suggested_fix: Add the relevant security/privacy documentation for the newly shipped SurrealDB remote client surface and legacy MCP HTTP session behavior, including authentication/session boundary implications.
